summary: @LibrariansReed I am going to have to disagree. I think we need to be way more subjective when it comes to our science and teaching around #OER and #OpenPedagogy. I want a movement, we may agree we do not have one, but that doesn't negate necessity.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @LibrariansReed I am going to have to disagree. I think we need to be way more subjective when it comes to our science and teaching around #OER and #OpenPedagogy. I want a movement, we may agree we do not have one, but that doesn't negate necessity.
